Roth.approxSet_num_den_mem_aux✝ {α κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : (h, q) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ) :
  ((↑h / ↑q).num, (↑h / ↑q).den) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ

private theorem Roth.approxSet_num_den_mem_aux : ∀ {α κ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ κ → ∀ {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ}, (h, q) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ → ((↑h / ↑q).num, (↑h / ↑q).den) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ :=
fun {α κ} hκ {h} {q} hq ↦
  let x := ↑h / ↑q;
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (_a.num, _a.den) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ)
        (have this := rfl;
        this)))
    (have hden :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd hq.left
        (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp
          (id
            (Eq.mp
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Dvd.dvd
                  (congrArg Nat.cast
                    (congrArg Rat.den
                      (Eq.trans (Rat.divInt_eq_div h ↑q) (congrArg (HDiv.hDiv ↑h) (Int.cast_natCast q))))))
                ↑q)
              (Rat.den_dvd h ↑q))));
    ⟨Rat.den_pos x,
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |α - _a| < 1 / ↑(x.num, x.den).2 ^ κ) (Eq.symm (Rat.cast_def (↑h / ↑q)))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |α - _a| < 1 / ↑(x.num, x.den).2 ^ κ) (Rat.cast_div ↑h ↑q)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |α - _a / ↑↑q| < 1 / ↑(x.num, x.den).2 ^ κ) (Rat.cast_intCast h)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |α - ↑h / _a| < 1 / ↑(x.num, x.den).2 ^ κ) (Rat.cast_natCast q)))
              (LT.lt.trans_le hq.right
                (div_le_div₀
                  (le_of_lt
                    (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                      (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1))))
                  (le_refl 1) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Nat.cast_pos'.mpr (Rat.den_pos (↑h / ↑q))) κ)
                  (Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt (Nat.cast_pos'.mpr (Rat.den_pos (↑h / ↑q)))) (Nat.mono_cast hden)
                    hκ))))))⟩)

  0 ≤ κ → ∀ {h : ℤ} {q : ℕ}, (h, q) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ → ((↑h / ↑q).num, (↑h / ↑q).den) ∈ Roth.approxSet α κ
